thread.text: Confirmed from your screenshot: at the bottom of the house you stand under the inventory bar, and the camera cannot scroll you above it (the room is only 12 tiles tall). The tutorial panel also covers the top-right. Which fix do you want? (A) Follow your backpack decision: hide the bar, show only a small equipped-item icon in a corner, full backpack on B. (B) Keep a compact bar (about half size) that fades out when you walk behind it. (C) Keep the bar and give the camera extra room so the player always stays above the UI. My pick: A, plus C as a safety net so no panel can ever cover the player. OK?
